output.reason: The evidence doesn't support setting-ignored, and it doesn't settle what the consequence is. The release note [ev-685e81f5b751] and PR #6655 [ev-faeed8b582d4] only say that `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` was removed from the modern XR schema. The PR's stated reason is that the v2 conformance tests failed on this "unexpected field". This is a status field, not a value an operator configures, so "configured values stop being honoured" overstates it. Nothing in the evidence says whether modern XRs ever filled in this field, or whether anything reading it breaks. Without that, I can't tell whether the right kind is none, behavior-change or a failure kind.
